correctness.rationale: Explicit F_2^4 Cayley definition fixes graph and tie-free rule. Walsh characters give exact adjacency spectrum {5:1,1:10,-3:5}. For a nonconstant fixed coloring with minority k<=8, the cross-edge cut obeys k(16-k)/4 <= |boundary| <=2k, forcing k=8 and equality; each vertex then sees exactly two opposite and three same neighbors, equivalent to As=s. A complete 65536-state exact functional digraph via indegree pruning proves F^6=F^4, full entrance/period/basin table, 142 fixed, 1165 2-cycles, with the explicit depth-four witness 431->1163->292->1024->0. An independent direct-bit-sum iteration and 1920-element affine automorphism enumeration validates 14 classes, basin isolation and every layer. Both standalone programs and their outputs are embedded and were run successfully.

value.rationale: The Clebsch graph is the unique 16-vertex degree-five strongly regular graph of parameters (16,5,0,2), and the antipodal-edge completion of Q4. It is a canonical high-symmetry graph where majority has no ties. The exact spectrum is a natural complete finite classification and, beyond code counts, its spectral cut obstruction forces every nonuniform equilibrium to be a balanced 1-eigenvector and reveals that all 140 are dynamically inaccessible from any other state. The transition from the previously computed Q4 702/885 counts to Clebsch 142/1165, along with 14 geometric types and nine basin sizes, describes a substantive dynamical effect of antipodal edges; the precise invariants can serve as canonical comparison benchmarks. No generalized theorem is needed for this finite structural classification.
